ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixel distribution (~75%) contrasted against low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral and markings distribution (~25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity pixel mapping is concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary, with a prominent dark vertical-linear cluster on the inner right lobe and isolated dark focal points on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate acute angle of 50 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke midpoint.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys, with increased amplitude and frequency towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves along the trailing edges, tapering into sharp, pointed distal tips (flukes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups (white on dark) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity lobe surfaces, most notably a parallel set of marks on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the medial-right lobe; irregular topographical 'chips' or missing segments along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark circular pixel cluster located in the central-medial region of the left lobe surface.
